message: The other day, I found myself in the kitchen trying to remember the last time we practiced our fire escape plan. Instead of scrolling through my phone, I decided to gather the kids for a little low-tech fun — we made a game out of mapping out our escape route! 🗺️ It turned into a family bonding moment, and we all felt a bit more prepared. Who knew a little planning could spark so much joy? Have you revisited your escape plans lately?
